mapper.sql: SELECT apr50_bookmark.* , ( f_emp_kor_nm(apr50_person_id) ||' (' ||f_get_emptrans(apr50_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') ||')' ) AS apr50_person_info , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS apr50_status_nm , apr01_reg_date AS apr50_reg_date , f_cdnm('AprInOutTypeCode', apr01_inout_cd, apr01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS apr50_inout_nm , apr01_title AS apr50_title , f_emp_kor_nm(apr01_reg_emp_id) AS apr50_reg_emp_nm , apr01_effect_date AS apr50_effect_date , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(apr01_class_tree_id) AS apr50_class_tree_nm FROM apr50_bookmark INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr50_appr_id WHERE apr50_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( apr50_person_id = #{personId} OR apr50_public_yn = #{publicYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT apr50_bookmark_id AS bookmark_id , apr50_appr_id AS appr_id , apr50_status_nm AS status_name , apr50_reg_date AS reg_date , apr50_inout_nm AS in_out_type_name , apr50_title AS title , apr50_reg_emp_nm AS reg_emp_name , apr50_effect_date AS effect_date , apr50_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name FROM ( ) apr50 WHERE CONCAT(apr50_title, apr50_person_info, apr50_class_tree_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY apr50_person_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
